commands.name: RecomputeGroupingProposals
input: trigger task/objective ids or full recompute request
steps: under stable snapshot read compact eligible Task/current-plan/current membership/lock/objective tuples
run algorithms/overlap-grouping.json globally for affected temporal neighborhood or full workset
compare desired strict-overlap components/current accepted membership and plan pins
respect terminal/membership locks and accepted manual exceptions; produce exact create/join/move/repin/consolidate or conflict previews
suppress exact previously rejected material fingerprint unless explicitly reconsidered
persist non-authoritative proposal rows in bounded UoW/job transaction
rules: exact-touch alone creates no automatic overlap edge

commands.name: AcceptRegroupProposal
steps: load exact persisted proposal outside lock for display
inside one UoW re-read every affected Task current plan, membership pin/revision, effective locks, affected Objective state/envelope and current interval neighbors
reject terminal Objective restructuring

for in-progress Objective allow only high-risk add/repin of unstarted unlocked work whose accepted current plan remains inside the current in-progress envelope; no consolidation/split/move of started/protected work
recompute exact material fingerprint and global nonoverlap
choose consolidation survivor deterministically as lowest tracking_sequence existing planned Objective; create new Objective only when no existing survivor
insert receipt
apply membership add/move/repin rows/events, mark merged-away planned Objectives superseded, create Objective when required
rebuild envelope/aggregate projections and re-run indexed overlap guard
transition proposal accepted, audit exact diff/result refs and commit
rules: membership pins current accepted plan revision at acceptance
regroup never changes Task execution/outcome/source plan

commands.name: RejectRegroupProposal
steps: inside UoW verify exact pending proposal/fingerprint
insert receipt
transition rejected and append minimized rejection fingerprint/reason
audit and commit
commands.rule: newer unrelated source/global changes do not re-present identical material grouping input

commands.name: ReconsiderRegroupInputs
steps: inside UoW mark exact rejection event explicitly reconsidered without deleting it
insert receipt/audit and commit
run fresh grouping preview from current material inputs
commands.rule: reconsideration is explicit operator decision, not silent fingerprint invalidation

commands.name: AcceptHistoricalObjectiveProposal
steps: inside UoW revalidate WFM provider lifecycle=complete, exact source projection revision/source plan, unassigned Task and no Task execution/outcome evidence

if an existing current operational plan exactly matches the proposal source interval, use that revision; otherwise insert receipt then append a dedicated task_plan_revision origin=historical_source_structure from the exact accepted source-plan evidence and make it current only when no protected conflicting current plan exists
prove the plan interval does not overlap any current accepted Objective; overlap returns stale/not eligible rather than rewriting terminal history
allocate Objective MW identity
ensure receipt exists exactly once, insert historical Objective, membership pinned to the exact selected/new historical plan revision and historical membership event
transition proposal accepted
rebuild envelope/aggregate as historical_structure with no execution/outcome
audit structure-only result and commit
rules: provider Complete plus valid accepted source plan is sufficient evidence to propose reviewed historical structure
accepting the historical structure may accept that exact source plan into a dedicated historical Task-plan revision, but source/import acceptance alone never does
source Complete/plan never fabricate Task actual start/end/outcome, Device work, spare use or Inventory consequence

commands.name: RejectHistoricalObjectiveProposal
steps: revalidate exact pending proposal
insert receipt
transition rejected/audit
commit
commands.rule: WFM remains terminal unassigned history and may receive a later proposal only after material supporting evidence changes or explicit reconsideration workflow

commands.name: SetHistoricalTaskOperationalCountInclusion
steps: inside UoW require provider-historical/historical-Objective eligibility
if requested current effective state equal use NO_CHANGE
insert receipt and inclusion event/current projection
rebuild Objective aggregate included/excluded counts; if all current historical members excluded set derived excluded_from_operational_counts
invalidate current reporting/review fingerprints but never identity/history
audit and commit
